_comment: BUG-002 one-variable-at-a-time test, arm B, dated 2026-10-03: identical to single_channel_bidirectional_600 except duration_ms matches two_channel_arming_check_600_bins_off's 3000ms, isolating run length as a confound - a 2026-10-03 scan found this file's un-matched 8000ms version scored only 2/18 (11%) clean against bins_off's 17/20 (85%), a result later checks showed can't be explained by tick timing (clean and reboot runs had identical arming_call timing within each scenario) - so run length and wiring differences (this file's pin 8 is plain unidirectional; bins_off's equivalent line is an idle-but-released bidirectional one) are the remaining candidates. This was all investigated before BUG-002's actual root cause (the harness's own arm_group() check) was found 2026-10-10 - the 2/18 and 17/20 figures above were measured with that check still present, so they may reflect the confound rather than run length or wiring, and this comparison has not been re-run since the fix to find out. Arm C ('..._short_padded_tick') no longer exists as a file.
